summary: Bethel is a town in Pitt County, North Carolina, with a population of 1,577 at the 2010 Census. It is part of the Greenville Metropolitan Area in the state's Inner Banks region. The note also points out that three other North Carolina towns share the name Bethel, located in Northeast, North-Central, and Mountain regions.
one_line: Bethel is a Pitt County, North Carolina town in the Greenville Metropolitan Area, one of four NC towns named Bethel.
key_facts: Bethel is a town in Pitt County, North Carolina, United States.
The population of Bethel was 1,577 at the 2010 Census.
Bethel is a part of the Greenville Metropolitan Area.
Bethel is located in North Carolina's Inner Banks region.
There are three other towns in North Carolina named "Bethel."
One Bethel is between Edenton and Hertford in the "Finger Counties" region in the Northeast corner of North Carolina.
Another Bethel is in the North-Central part of North Carolina in Caswell County.
The third Bethel is located in the Mountain Region of North Carolina in Haywood County.
